Primquisite Real Estate

Primquisite Real Estate is a property developer and real estate agency in Lagos, Nigeria. We develop luxury residential projects, provide property management, and serve investors and residents across Lekki Phase 1, Ikoyi, and Nigeria.

Primary services:
- Property development and investment
- PropTech and digital estate management
- Operations and asset management
- Risk, transparency, and compliance
- Enterprise data and intelligence
